## MoodBuro 0.2.0

- Signed automatic updates through GitHub Releases, with version information, release notes, download progress and explicit installation/relaunch controls in Settings → General. Automatic checks run at launch and every six hours and can be disabled.
- Selected course-file synchronization with saved-copy freshness, scheduled refreshes, cancellation, restart recovery and protection for local edits.
- Live Apple Calendar subscription setup alongside existing ICS exports and local reminders.
- Download progress/cancellation, completion actions, menu-bar-only mode, opt-in launch at login and Finder folder setup.
- Explicitly confirmed file uploads to supported individual assignment drafts, without final submission.
- Grouped Settings and assistant provider setup improvements.

### Install or upgrade

Download the universal macOS DMG (Apple Silicon and Intel), verify it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, quit MoodBuro, then drag the app into Applications. **Install 0.2.0 manually**: earlier releases do not include the updater. Subsequent normal releases use the stable update feed; prereleases are excluded.

The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. macOS may require first-launch approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security. macOS 12 is the configured minimum; full supported-platform, Intel runtime and installed update qualification remain in progress. Apple Developer ID signing/notarization remain planned.

Updater archives have a separate cryptographic signature. Local settings, credentials and saved files retain their existing storage locations; installed upgrade preservation and failure recovery remain part of platform qualification.

### Assets

- Universal `.dmg` installer
- Signed `.app.tar.gz` update archive and `.sig`
- `latest.json` stable update manifest for both Mac architectures
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
